data.how_to_apply: Applicants can be undergraduate, Master's, Ph.D. full- or part-time students from computer science or related fields. They receive a complimentary conference registration, free lunches/refreshments, and volunteer garments in exchange for approximately 18 hours of work covering four days at the conference. To apply, fill out the provided form before November 10th, 2025.
